visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with black hair and bangs, wearing a white crop top and dental braces, stands in a studio. She looks directly at the camera with a cheerful expression, gesturing with her hands while speaking. The background features a minimalist light grey wall and a black desk lamp. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a grey mechanical keyboard and an ergonomic wireless mouse resting on a light-colored wooden desk. Small green succulents in white pots are visible in the blurred background, creating a clean workspace aesthetic. (3) The woman is shown in a professional office environment, seated at a desk with a dual-monitor setup. She is actively using the mouse and typing on the keyboard, looking focused. The lighting is bright and even across the workstation. (4) Back in the studio, she holds the Logitech MX Master 4 mouse towards the camera. Graphic overlays highlighting the product name appear around her. She demonstrates the mouse's physical grip and the placement of the thumb rest buttons. (5) Detailed macro shots showcase the mouse's texture, the 'Actions Ring' logo near the thumb rest, and the metallic scroll wheel. A screen capture demonstrates a circular software menu with various application icons like ChatGPT and Instagram. (6) Close-up shots focus on a hand pressing the side buttons of the mouse. The camera pans across the textured surface of the device, emphasizing the ergonomic design and the precision of the side scroll wheel. (7) A product comparison graphic appears, showing the mouse in two distinct colors: Graphite and Pearl. The background is a clean white space with subtle geometric accents. The woman returns to the frame holding the Pearl version. (8) Transition to a close-up of the MX Mechanical Mini keyboard. A hand is shown typing on the low-profile keys. The camera captures the tactile movement of the keys and the compact layout of the grey and dark grey keycaps. (9) A low-light shot demonstrates the keyboard's smart backlighting feature, with white light illuminating the characters on the keys. A screen recording displays the 'Logi Options+' software interface used for customizing light effects. (10) The woman holds the keyboard and mouse together, smiling at the camera. Text overlays showing pricing in NT$ and promotional bundles with Adobe Creative Cloud appear on the screen as she provides a closing recommendation.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy, female narrator speaking in Traditional Chinese with a friendly and professional tone. An upbeat electronic pop background music track starts simultaneously, featuring a steady 124 BPM synthesized beat and bright melodic sequences. The vocal delivery is clear and well-enunciated. (2) As the narration introduces specific product features, the speech rate remains consistent. The background music maintains a rhythmic foundation with strong electronic percussion. No ambient noise is present, indicating a high-quality studio recording. (3) Subtle digital user-interface sound effects, such as soft 'dings' and 'clicks', are layered into the mix during software demonstrations. These SFX are crisp and have a narrow frequency bandwidth. (4) Distinct mechanical keyboard clacking sounds are introduced when showcasing the typing experience. These transients are sharp and clearly audible against the music bed. The narrator’s voice modulates with enthusiasm when describing performance gains. (5) The recording ends with a closing statement and a call to action. The background music remains constant in energy before a quick fade-out. The spectral balance is bright, emphasizing high-frequency clarity in both the vocals and the synthesized instruments.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional review and endorsement for the Logitech MX Master 4 mouse and MX Mechanical Mini keyboard. It aims to convince professionals and heavy computer users that these peripherals will significantly enhance their productivity and comfort through specialized features like AI integration, ergonomic design, and silent typing.
